reserveReview.rationale: On-chain capture at IOTA checkpoint 193768193 (2026-09-21T08:40:49.164Z) read all four live shared Virtue vaults. Vault balances were 2,410.072442864 IOTA, 8,950,007.805576865 stIOTA, 3,000.003905922 vIOTA, and 0.0149549784 iBTC. Current NativePool and cert::Metadata objects imply exchange rates of 1.1641401807 IOTA/stIOTA and 1.0659272095 IOTA/vIOTA. CoinGecko spot values observed with the capture were $0.04799262 IOTA/USD and $83,802 BTC/USD. The resulting collateral values were approximately $115.67, $500,038.17, $153.47, and $1,253.26, normalized to 0.02%, 99.70%, 0.03%, and 0.25% (100.00% total). The composition is fully identified at the capture point; no independent reserve attestation or legal custody assurance is published.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The 2026-09-21 capture shows collateral in four shared protocol vault objects, so on-chain custody remains omnibus at the protocol and branch level rather than an identified bank or segregated account. The package is immutable but an AdminCap gates supply limits and module versions, and liquidations run through a configured executor. No independent reserve attestation, legal segregation statement, bankruptcy-remoteness opinion, rehypothecation policy, or other assurance report covering the current collateral was found in the reviewed issuer documentation or on-chain sources.
